query:
SELECT v.id, v.clienteNome, v.valorColetado, v.valorFaturado, v.comissaoPercent, v.custoServico, v.servicos, v.createdAt,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parcelas p WHERE p.vendaId = v.id) as qtdParcelas,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parcelas p WHERE p.vendaId = v.id AND p.okConsultor = 1) as parcelasPagas
FROM vendas v
WHERE v.id IN (510001, 540001);
